source_evidence_manifest.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: service access methods and account requirement
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: The service supports bulk CSV downloads and a developer API. Bulk certificate downloads require sign-in or account creation with GOV.UK One Login.

source_evidence_manifest.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: API availability, token acquisition and OpenAPI specification
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: The developer APIs expose domestic EPC, non-domestic EPC and DEC data. A GOV.UK One Login account is required to receive a bearer token. API interfaces are described using OpenAPI Specification version 3.

source_evidence_manifest.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: API base URL, HTTP method and mandatory authorization header
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: The API base URL is https://api.get-energy-performance-data.communities.gov.uk. Requests use GET with query-string parameters. An Authorization header containing a bearer token must be included and Accept is application/json.

source_evidence_manifest.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: domestic search endpoint, UPRN query contract and response field
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: GET /api/domestic/search supports an optional uprn parameter. The UPRN is a 12-digit unique property reference number left-padded with zeroes. Successful response examples include an uprn field.

source_evidence_manifest.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
